description: Create a new calendar event with title, date, time, optional description and location

all_day.description: Optional. All-day is inferred from the date format, so this is only needed to state the intent explicitly; it must agree with the format of start_date/end_date.

calendar_url.description: The URL of the calendar to create the event in

end_date.description: End, in the same form as start_date. For an all-day event the end is EXCLUSIVE: a single day on 2026-05-25 is start_date "2026-05-25" and end_date "2026-05-26".

start_date.description: Start in ISO 8601 format. A datetime ("2026-05-25T10:00:00Z") makes a timed event; a bare date ("2026-05-25") makes an all-day event.

name: create_event
